title: T=30000 checkpointed pair (kind-specific waste vs kind-blind twin) of c58's trait3d vortices on fresh seed 6 / mut_seed 6, then a larger box
summary: Started trait3c.py on seed 6 (mut_seed 6) to T=30000 in both arms at 128^2; interim results each loop; scored with c59's o_vortex.py plus a share-normalised threshold to separate real saturation from a fixed threshold made harder by standing diversity.
